ops.text: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Vendor, without penalty, early-termination charge, or acceleration of Fees. In that case Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees covering the period after the effective date of termination in accordance with Section 10.2. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or an Order Form for convenience during a term.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Customer termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, since this Agreement runs for a three-year term and Section 9 currently allows exit only for cause, insolvency, or security/SLA failures. Our playbook requires flexibility to exit without penalty; if helpful we can move to 60 days' notice as a fallback.
input.summary: Add Section 9.4 giving Customer a 30-day convenience termination right with pro-rata refund and confirming Vendor has none.
